regions.encounter_rule: Replay the ordered queue of nine stage bosses on floors 91–99.
Dragon from pick_monster called by battle_system.

floor_rules.normal_selection: Uniform choice from full or reduced region pool on remaining floors, except Ella overrides.
floor_rules.boss_exit: Append boss on entry. On victory, recover player, reset battle stats and restore saved skill uses before opening shop.

additional_stats.sampling: Draw two inclusive cuts from 0 to total, sort them, and use the three resulting segment lengths.
additional_stats.applies_to: Normal progression paths including fixed entry and midboss encounters when they use those paths. Stage bosses, Gate rematches, Ella and Dragon bypass it.

ella_encounters.condition: After a floor 74 win. Path 1 uses ID 53, path 2 uses ID 54.
After the last Gate boss win, path 1 and Ella encounter counter 0 add a battle on the same floor. Path 2 instead restores HP, stats and saved uses and opens the shop.

late_game.boss_order: FIFO in initial stage-boss encounter order, reset and recover each rematch.
late_game.lair_entry: Path 1 proceeds after winning the extra Ella fight. Path 2 proceeds from the shop's Enter next area action.
